There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded. There is an unblocked exit to the south. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unguarded.

summary: I went east to the spotless steam room.
thought: I should examine the floor in the spotless steam room to look for the coin.
feedback: You can't see any such thing.
